'''Bory''' was an [[Atmosphere/Legends|airless]] rock [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with no [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that occupied the second closest [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position to the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Asar/Legends|Asar]]. It was located within the [[Ilum system/Legends|Ilum system]], a part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']]<ref name="TEA" /> [[7G sector/Legends|7G sector]].<ref name="sector" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bory was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Bory, in grid square G-7.<ref name="TEA" />
